sources.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Full-bleed portrait 4:5 production puzzle painting, warm richly detailed oil/gouache storybook realism with subtle brush texture, coherent anatomy and perspective, no text, numerals, brands, famous places, border or UI. Complete natural scene, not a diagram. This clean plate will receive five small hand-painted animated objects later. Draw natural attachment surfaces but omit only the stated small details. Gently elevated intimate view of three anatomically correct small penguins standing together on a WARM TERRACOTTA orange-red rocky shoreline, calm restrained blue water in upper background, light warm sky. Dominant large foreground and midground terracotta rocks, black-white penguins with correct flippers and feet, no tropical plants. Five later moving detail zones: empty clear air above lower right water for a tiny seabird, calm nearshore water patch for ripple, one short bare tough grass tuft stem in left rock crevice for green frond, another small bare golden grass stalk near right edge for seed head, one exposed smooth rock for a little loose pale feather. Animals fully painted and not separated into parts.

sources.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production hand-painted game cutout atlas. 1536x1024 RGBA with genuine transparent empty background, no glow, colored haze, grid, labels or UI. Invisible three columns/two rows, exactly five objects in reading order and sixth lower-right empty. Each WHOLE object fits central 280x300 within its 512x512 cell, all sides surrounded by at least 100 transparent pixels. Oil/gouache brush texture, coherent warm natural light from upper-left. Fine clean edges, realistic materials. For a terracotta rocky penguin shoreline, paint (1) one small distant white-and-gray seabird in flight, side oblique view, correct wings, no water or sky; (2) one thin softly reflective nearly-horizontal elliptical water ripple, semitransparent, no glow; (3) a short tough green coastal grass sprig with thin joined root base; (4) one delicate straw-colored seed head on slender stalk; (5) one little pale gray-white feather lying flat on a rock viewed at low three-quarter angle, tight subtle contact shadow on transparency. No tropical foliage.
